sections.text: A sudden storm forces your airship down onto the deck of a floating citadel run by brass automatons. Gears click and hiss all around you as the fog clears.

options.description: Sneak into the maintenance tunnels
Approach the main gate and announce yourself

sections.text: The tunnels rattle with steam pipes. A gear-golem guard blocks the passage, its core glowing faintly through a chest panel.

options.description: Disable the golem's core gently
Rip out the core forcefully

consequence.text: The golem's arm slices your shoulder as it powers down.

sections.text: Two automaton guards block the gate, demanding a Citadel Seal you do not have.

options.description: Bluff that you're an Imperial inspector
Fight your way past

consequence.text: The guards' steam lances scorch your side as you barrel through.

sections.text: The golem powers down peacefully, its final gesture pointing you toward a hidden passage leading to the Cogwork Archive.

options.description: Follow the passage into the Archive

sections.text: The golem slumps, but the wrenched core sets off a citadel-wide alarm. Klaxons echo through the tunnels.

options.description: Run deeper into the tunnels

consequence.text: You bark your shin on a pipe joint as you sprint through the dark.

sections.text: The bluff works. A guard escorts you inside, muttering about overdue inspections.

options.description: Slip away from your escort toward the Archive
Play along and ask about the Citadel's Heart

sections.text: You break through the gate, wounded but inside. Alarms are already blaring across the citadel.

options.description: Flee into the maintenance tunnels

sections.text: The Cogwork Archive is lined with schematics. They reveal the citadel is powered by a storm spirit, chained to a great brass engine.

options.description: Free the storm spirit from the engine
Take the schematics and leave quietly

sections.text: Alarms chase you through the pipework until the tunnel opens back toward the Archive.

options.description: Push forward into the Archive

consequence.text: A ruptured steam vent scalds your hands as you scramble past.

sections.text: Your escort mentions the Heart chamber deep below, then eyes you with sudden suspicion.

options.description: Ask to see the Heart chamber
Excuse yourself and slip toward the Archive

sections.text: You wrench the chains free. The storm spirit rises in a blaze of light and lightning, and the citadel begins to shudder apart.

options.description: Ride the storm spirit to freedom
Try to calm the spirit and negotiate

consequence.text: The spirit's calming aura washes over you, mending your wounds.

sections.text: You slip away with the schematics, the citadel none the wiser. Scholars below will pay handsomely for this knowledge.
The suspicion turns to alarm. Guards close in around you at the threshold of the Heart chamber.

options.description: Surrender peacefully
Make a desperate dash back to the airship

consequence.text: A steam lance grazes your leg as you sprint for the docking ring.

sections.text: Riding atop the freed storm spirit, you soar away as the Clockwork Citadel crumbles into the clouds behind you.
Grateful for its freedom, the storm spirit gifts you a shard of its lightning-heart before dissolving into the open sky.
Brass clamps close around your wrists. Your airship days are over — for now.
Bleeding but free, you throw yourself aboard your airship as the citadel's alarms fade into the clouds below.
